question: Among players with at least 15 xG in 2024-2025, who had the highest goals-to-xG ratio?
answer: Among players with at least 15 xG in 2024-2025, **Chris Wood** had the highest goals-to-xG ratio at **1.28** (1.2788541466845706), scoring **20 goals** from an xG of **15.639**.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals,
       SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS xg,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) / SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS goals_to_xg_ratio
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = pss.season_id AND s.season = '2024-2025'
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = pss.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(pss.xg_pss) >= 15
ORDER BY SUM(pss.goals_pss) / SUM(pss.xg_pss) DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Filter player_season_stats by season_id for '2024-2025' (join seasons on season='2024-2025'). Grain is per player-team; if a player split across clubs, aggregate goals_pss and xg_pss by player_id. Apply HAVING SUM(xg_pss) >= 15, then ORDER BY SUM(goals_pss)/SUM(xg_pss) DESC LIMIT 1. Join players for display name. Alternatively use vw_player_season_summary (goals_pss, xg_pss, player_name) filtered on season='2024-2025'.
